[LREG.2.3] A **plain boolean** `where` clause — one with no capture-binding
prefix ([LREG.4.1]) — containing a `~` expression must use a pattern of zero
capturing groups. The compiler must reject a plain boolean `where` whose
pattern has captures with a message that names the offending pattern and
points the author at converting the captures to non-capturing groups
(`(?:...)`) or binding them with the capture-binding `where` form.
